skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
It hurts you every time you see these clothes, but upon closer inspection, the two of them don't look anything alike.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
She is no longer a part of the AMa-10 construct. She is Mon3tr, a member of Rhodes Island.

skins.name: Sharpened Claws
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Sharpened Claws. Mon3tr's new uniform after the most important reunion. Once again breaking through the theoretical limits of evolution and reconstruction, redefining the highest levels of sharpness and resilience.
skins.usage: One of Mon3tr's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: Through danger comes transformation; from clarity comes renewal.
